Name: Sherbet the Dinosaur
Author: augustlucian
Description: This is my first mod, and I decided to practice on the dinosaur first. While recoloring I realized it looked like my weighted plushie and emotional support dinosaur named Sherbet. So, I continued to recolor the dino in his likeness and have uploaded it here to share. I think it turned out kinda cute.
